name: Government of Nizhny Novgorod Oblast
note: The regional state government of Nizhny Novgorod Oblast, listed by HC Torpedo as a title partner on the club's own partner feed. Its logo on the club site is the oblast's coat of arms (a deer in a shield).

why.text: Torpedo is sponsored by the Government of Nizhny Novgorod Oblast, the state government of a region of Russia — a state that launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 and has been at war with Ukraine since, with UN human rights monitors documenting rising civilian casualties.
why.messageLine: Ask Torpedo about the sponsorship money from the Nizhny Novgorod region's government
